summary: Iter 68 — Backend + Frontend validation of the 5 add-on features: Duplicate Invoice, Duplicate Bill, Send Bill email, Apply Tax to All Lines (invoice + bill), Bulk CSV Tax Import. All 8 backend pytest cases pass. Backend: POST /invoices/{iid}/duplicate returns fresh id + INV-#### number + issue_date=today + due_date=today+30 + status='draft' + balance_due=total, with all fields (line_items, po_number, terms, discount, discount_type, shipping, tax, notes, internal_notes, attachments, title, summary, contact_name) copied verbatim; verified via GET on new id. Mirror is true for POST /bills/{bid}/duplicate → BILL-#### + status='open'. Both endpoints return 404 for unknown ids. POST /bills/{bid}/send-email works with ?to= override (returns {status,to,email_log_id}); returns 400 when neither contact nor override has an email; 404 for unknown bill. Bulk-tax-import with the exact spec payload returns created=2, updated=0, skipped list of 2 rows with correct reasons ('rate must be between 0 and 100', 'name is empty'); idempotent re-run returns created=0,updated=0,skipped=2; re-run with GST rate changed to 6 returns updated=1 and rate is persisted (verified via GET). Frontend (client@axiom.ai on TEST_dup company): Invoice editor Duplicate button navigates to /invoices/{newId}/edit with a fresh INV-#### number. Bill editor Duplicate mirrors it (fresh BILL-####). Bill Send-to-vendor dialog opens, accepts an email in bill-send-to, Send closes the dialog and completes. Apply-tax-to-every-line dropdown on both editors picks a tax and stamps it onto line-0's tax select (verified matching tax_id). Tax Library Import CSV opens dialog with textarea + example collapsible + live preview showing 2 OK + 2 Skip rows with 'rate out of range' and 'empty name' reasons; submit button shows 'Import 2 rows', click closes the dialog and refreshes the table with GST and HST rows. Regression: existing InvoiceEditor duplicate does NOT overwrite the source (verified source id still fetchable); tax library CRUD path still works.

minor.issue: Duplicate copies the source's `updated_at`? No — helper resets. BUT: existing.tax on source docs already includes rolled-up per-line tax (see iter 67 minor). Since duplicate copies the stored tax verbatim without recomputing, the new doc starts with the same rolled-up value. Not a bug today because a subsequent PATCH would recompute; flagging for symmetry with the iter67 double-count analysis.

Backend uses 'rate must be between 0 and 100' and 'name is empty'; frontend preview shows 'rate out of range' and 'empty name'. Two independent validators — they agree on which rows to skip but the human-readable strings drift, so a user comparing preview vs server response sees mismatched wording. Minor UX inconsistency.

ui_bugs.issue: Dropdown has TWO options with value="" — the disabled placeholder 'Choose tax…' AND the enabled '— clear —' choice. HTML/Playwright cannot distinguish them by value; automated test cannot programmatically pick '— clear —', and there's a small chance the browser highlights the wrong one after clear. Fix: use a sentinel value like '__clear__' for the clear option and branch in the onChange handler.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Comes from the dev-time instrumentation wrapping dynamic {t.name} in a <span data-ve-dynamic>. Only appears in preview build; ship-build should be fine, but worth confirming.

action_items: Consider replacing the empty-value '— clear —' option with a distinct sentinel to make the apply-tax-all dropdown testable and unambiguous.
Align skip-reason strings between frontend preview and backend response for the CSV import (either preview echoes the server reason after submit, or both use the same constants).
iter 67 latent PATCH double-count is still present — not exercised by the new duplicate endpoints but worth cleaning up when touching _sum_lines again.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/invoices.py _duplicate_doc uses `doc = {**src}` (shallow copy) — line_items and attachments arrays share references with the source doc. If any caller mutates the source's line_items between find_one and insert_one they would leak into the dup. Low-risk today (no such caller) but a deepcopy would be safer.

Both /bills/{bid}/send-email and /invoices/{iid}/send-email use `kind='customer_statement'` for the dispatch preference bucket — a vendor cannot opt out of bill notifications independently of customer statements. Consider a distinct 'vendor_bill_copy' preference key.

Bulk-import loop hits Mongo twice per row (find_one + insert/update). For a paste of a few hundred rows it's still snappy, but a single aggregate + bulk_write would scale better and give an atomic result.
Bulk-import doesn't cap `rows` length — a paste of 100k rows would hold the request open. Add a max_rows guard (e.g. 500) with a 400 response.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created TEST_INV_DUP_68, TEST_BILL_DUP_68, TEST_BILL_SEND_68, TEST_BILL_NO_EMAIL_68 (all deleted). Playwright UI walkthrough duplicated one existing invoice (INL-4c9b7 → INV-9641) and one existing bill (BILL-9125 → BILL-1846) on TEST_dup company; these duplicates remain in the DB for main-agent inspection. UITEST_GST_68 and UITEST_HST_68 taxes created and then cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The apply-tax-all dropdown's '— clear —' option shares value='' with the disabled placeholder — Playwright's select_option(value='') cannot target it deterministically. Use page.evaluate to set the select's value and dispatch a change event, OR fix the option to use a sentinel like '__clear__'. Bulk-import endpoint accepts JSON with `rows` array only (frontend parses CSV client-side). PATCH double-count from iter67 is still latent.
